status: resident CUDA separate-scale row decoder and pinned-cache probe coupling qualified; whole Engram/model integration remains open

implementation.registry: BnQuantRowDecodeKind/BN_QUANT_ROW_GPU_INT4_FP16S32_BF16 in BnQuantRowScaledOps; platform-neutral metadata controls backend dispatch.
implementation.operator: Existing quant_rows_bf16_resident/BnGPUQuantRowsBF16ResidentPlan extended with separate request-owned F16 scales. Legacy IQ4_NL embedded-scale path retained.
implementation.source: src/gpu_cuda_rows.cuh, included by the existing CUDA translation unit. No new kernel translation unit or global fast-math changes.
implementation.math: Four adjacent nibble values per thread, one FP16 scale per32 values; exact F32 integer-times-half product (__fmul_rn), explicit BF16 RNE store. Signed zeros retained.
implementation.geometry: bn_gpu_scaled_rows_shape: raw rows1..1048576,cols32..65536 divisible32,count<=INT32_MAX. Exact I32 packed count=rows*cols/8,F16 scale count=rows*cols/32,BF16 out count=rows*cols;packed stride=cols/2.
implementation.validation: Owner/type/count/generation/overlap/geometry validation before launch. GPU tensor values are a caller precondition: finite nonnegative source scales must be established before upload. The coupled probe validates raw host scales through the scalar quant-domain helper.
implementation.lifetime: Request-owned disjoint views; caller retains them through stream completion. No allocation, copy or completion fence inside decoder.

reference.primary: Unchanged Diffbot Triton BF16 lookup from previous row-reference capture; source/payload SHAs verified before and after.
reference.exhaustive: Every one of31744 finite nonnegative FP16 scales and all16 nibbles (twice),1015808 original BF16 words compared directly byte for byte, beyond the in-tree unit checksum.
reference.unit: 36 valid guarded calls,4497536 BF16 words; two requests/two repetitions, freshly poisoned output each call. Geometry through65536 columns, bad owner/type/count/generation/alias/null cases and stale views after resize.
reference.coupled: Two actual tables,1026 sampled rows each,32KiB/256KiB host-cache budgets,two passes,72 calls5384448 raw/BF16 bytes exact; each probe also runs the standalone exhaustive call. All explicit test readbacks outside trace ROI.
reference.placement: Probe uses existing two-slot pinned upload API: direct cache gather into acquired leases,domain check,two async H2D submissions,one decoder kernel. Not yet a production backend-owned staging controller.
reference.payload_bounds: Host cache allocations262112/32632 bytes; pinned payload32768 bytes; max staged device payload84240 bytes including guards. Separate index/source/caller/allocator/context overhead not included.

qualification.asan_scope: Coupled probe plus CPU cache/source, storage, JSON/platform and scalar scale-domain helper. CUDA host/kernel translation unit not ASan instrumented; candidate GPU kernel covered by MEMCHECK/INITCHECK/RACECHECK.
qualification.race_scope: 36 bounded new row primitive unit calls only; no full-core/controller race run.
qualification.profile_scope: Warm code, one candidate kernel; stage profiles also include real cache gather and two pinned H2D submits. All explicit test readbacks outside ROI. One caller completion fence inside ROI.
